subtitle: Launch Operations, Flight Software Provenance & Starlink Telemetry
scope_note: Strictly advisory, non-actuating telemetry observability and ground/orbital link resilience proposals (executed=False, zero flight-computer actuation).

primary_strengths: High-cadence reusable launch operations, rapid pad turnaround, and global Starlink constellation.
Rich multi-vehicle telemetry streams spanning propulsion, avionics, GSE, and orbital links.
Iterative hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and flight-proven telemetry review culture.
core_bottlenecks: Siloed terminal-count operator consoles obscure slow cross-subsystem margin collapse.
80-400 ms Starlink LEO beam handovers drop unbuffered telemetry and rigid transfers.
Compressed webcast/HUD video lacks frame-locked cryptographic telemetry provenance and tactile access.
system_profile.design_north_star: Read-only A_tau(p_t) Causal Chiasm triage, SHA-256 sealed HIL-to-flight provenance, and range-resumable orbital buffers.

improvements.title: Read-Only Superlevel-Set A_tau(p_t) Mode-Transition Chiasm Advisor
improvements.current_gap: Terminal count and ascent operators track dozens of siloed propellant, valve, avionics, and range screens where transient noise is hard to separate from irreversible margin collapse.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Fold 8 normalized subsystem margin regimes into a strictly read-only (executed=False, air-gapped telemetry tap, zero flight-computer actuation) Causal Chiasm HUD surfacing A_tau(p_t) repertoire collapse and hold-point bottleneck alerts.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Uses causal_chiasm() future_boxed_in and persistent_filtration_tomography() invariants across scrub vs. nominal rehearsals.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: CountdownChiasm-v1 read-only advisory panel + 10 Hz replayable telemetry evaluator.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Advisory alert fatigue during nominal transients. Mitigation: require persistence across >= 3 consecutive 10 Hz frames before elevating HUD state.
improvements.verification_method: Replay historical/synthetic scrub vs. nominal rehearsal traces; verify < 5 ms tick budget and zero actuation interfaces.

improvements.title: SHA-256 Sealed HIL, Monte Carlo & Webcast Flight-Frame Provenance
improvements.current_gap: Compressed webcast HUD pixels lose exact mission-time provenance, and Monte Carlo / HIL campaigns lack compact cryptographic manifests linking flight software builds to telemetry.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Emit a frame_sha256-keyed JSON sidecar (t_mission_s, alt_km, vel_km_s, q_kpa, stage_state, flight_sw_sha256) linking HIL Monte Carlo runs and launch webcasts to immutable build hashes.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Extends fieldglass-causal-chiasm/v1 report_sha256 canonical JSON sealing to flight archives.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: FlightFrameSeal sidecar generator + offline anomaly diff CLI.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Public webcast timing offset vs. internal mission clock. Mitigation: publish clean public-tier quantized 10 Hz sidecar with explicit T-0 alignment.
improvements.verification_method: Verify 100% deterministic SHA-256 round-trip across simulated 900 s launch telemetry logs.

improvements.title: Persistent Filtration GSE & Cryo Quick-Disconnect Drift Watch
improvements.current_gap: High-cadence launch turnarounds stress LOX/CH4 valves, cryo quick-disconnects, and helium purge lines, where subtle cycle-to-cycle hysteresis precedes hard faults.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Compute cross-campaign persistent_filtration_tomography() over normalized valve actuation times and seal-pressure decay signatures to flag P(x) < 0.14 invariant erosion early.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Monitors structural_invariants vs. transient_states across static-fire and launch cycles.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Ambient temperature swings mimic seal drift. Mitigation: normalize actuation curves against pad cryo-manifold temperature bins.
improvements.verification_method: Inject synthetic 2-8% valve-sluggishness ramp over 24 cycles; verify tomography flags drift by cycle 12.

improvements.title: Starlink LEO Handover HTTP 206 Ring Buffer & Conjunction Explainability
improvements.current_gap: 80-400 ms LEO satellite beam handovers drop unbuffered telemetry and rigid transfers, while autonomous conjunction-avoidance logs lack concise operator maneuver rationales.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Deploy a 64 MB terminal edge ring buffer supporting HTTP 206 Partial Content range-resume with SHA-256 checkpoints, paired with an interpretable ConjunctionLedger detailing ephemeris uncertainty cones and delta-V tradeoff rationale.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: OrbitalHandoverBuffer proxy spec + ConjunctionLedger JSON schema.

improvements.title: High-Contrast Dark-Observatory Anomaly HUD & 2x4 Braille Trajectory Plates
improvements.current_gap: Dense multi-color console displays increase cognitive load during off-nominal events, and purely visual flight curves exclude blind/low-vision engineers and enthusiasts.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Standardize a low-glare dark-observatory anomaly HUD (#0b0f17, cyan/gold/ruby semantic severity) and co-emit 72-column 2x4 Unicode Braille ascent/landing trajectory plates with ARIA milestone callouts (Max-Q, MECO, Entry Burn, Catch).
improvements.concrete_deliverable: BrailleTrajectory exporter + dark-observatory operator alert stylesheet.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Rapidly changing curves blur at 72x28 resolution. Mitigation: emit discrete phase-keyed altitude/velocity plates at Max-Q, MECO, and Landing.
improvements.verification_method: Verify generated trajectory Braille plates preserve clear ascent/booster curves and pass WCAG contrast >= 7:1.
